main_text.p: eo quod refert modò laudatus Ebn Chalican, sc. Cùm jam evulgari coepissed Alcoranus, non repertum fuisse in universa regione Taman, qui Arabicè scribendi, vel legendi peritus esset. Certè ipsum Mohammedem utriusque literaturæ partis ignarum unanimi consensu statuunt, ideòque Nabiyan Ommian, i. e. Prophetam illiteratum vocant. Author جامع ام القرى اللغة Ommalkora, Mater Pagorum appellatur, juxta quorundam sententiam tribui asserit, sed eodem res recidit: nam vel hoc ipsum ad ejus imperitiam evincendam firmum satis est argumentum, quòd Meccensis fuerit. Quod nos docet Shareftanius his verbis, الفرقتان المتعقا بلتان قبل المبعث هم اهل الكتاب والامیون والامي من لا يعرف الكتابة فكانت اليهود والنصاري بالمدينة والامیون بمكة i. e. Dua secta op-posita ante missionem Mohammedis erant, populus libri, & Idiota. Idiota est qui literas nescit. Judæi autem & Christiani Medinam incolebant, Idiota autem Meccam. Hæc ille. Judæos & Christianos Populum libri vocant, non solùm quòd ipsis libri religionis eorum præcepta continentes dati sint, sed & quòd literas didicissent, contra ac Arabes Meccenses qui eâ quâ nati sunt ignorantiâ totam vitam ducebant. Ita inquit Author libri Mogreb vocabulum الامي Ommio, seu Idiota منسوب الي امة العرب وهي لم تكن في اللغة تكتب ولا تقرأ فاستعير لكل من لا يعرف الكتابة ولا القراة i. e. Ex vi vocis denominatur ab Ommah, i. Natione Arabum, utpote quæ nec scriberet nec legeret, atque inde translatum ad denotandum quemlibet, qui scri-bendo

page.notes: The Arabic is printed irregularly and is not fully legible; the Arabic readings, including the Author line (جامع ام القرى), the Shareftanius passage and the Mogreb passage, are transcribed from the scan on a best-effort basis and may contain errors. The marginal note "Seft." is read as printed (long s with t ligature), probably for Sect. The running head is NOTÆ. The Latin words "Ebn Chalican" and "Shareftanius" are kept as printed. No Greek or Hebrew apart from the Arabic. Digitiser's stamp "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is omitted.
